judgments.en_span: In this announcement, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the following meanings:
judgments.zh_span: 於本公告內，除文義另有所指外，下列詞語具有以下涵義：
judgments.explanation: Both passages convey the same introductory statement for the definitions section with equivalent meaning.

judgments.en_span: "Acquisition" means the acquisition of the Sale Shares by the Company from the Vendor pursuant to the Agreement
judgments.zh_span: 「收購事項」指本公司根據本協議向賣方收購銷售股份
judgments.explanation: Both define Acquisition identically using the glossary terms (Company, Sale Shares, Vendor, Agreement).

judgments.en_span: "Agreement" means the conditional sale and purchase agreement dated 23 September 2026 entered into between the Company and the Vendor in relation to the Acquisition
judgments.zh_span: 「本協議」指本公司與賣方就收購事項於二零二六年九月二十三日訂立的有條件買賣協議
judgments.explanation: Both define Agreement identically, referencing the same date, parties, and nature of the agreement.

judgments.en_span: "associate(s)" has the meaning ascribed to it under the Listing Rules
judgments.zh_span: 「聯繫人」具有上市規則所賦予的涵義
judgments.explanation: Both definitions defer to the Listing Rules for the meaning of associates/聯繫人.
Both define Board as the board of Directors using the glossary term.

judgments.en_span: "Business Day" means a day (other than a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday) on which licensed banks in Hong Kong are generally open for business
judgments.zh_span: 「營業日」指香港持牌銀行一般開門營業的日子（星期六、星期日或公眾假期除外）
judgments.explanation: Both definitions of Business Day are equivalent, specifying the same exclusions and criteria.

judgments.en_span: "Company" means Meridian Pacific Holdings Limited, a company incorporated in the Cayman Islands with limited liability, the Shares of which are listed on the Main Board of the Stock Exchange (stock code: 1877)
judgments.zh_span: 「本公司」指明源太平洋控股有限公司，一間於開曼群島註冊成立的有限公司，其股份於聯交所主板上市（股份代號：1877）
judgments.explanation: Both definitions identify the same company with identical incorporation details and stock code.

judgments.en_span: "Completion" means completion of the Acquisition in accordance with the terms of the Agreement
judgments.zh_span: 「完成」指根據本協議的條款完成收購事項
judgments.explanation: Both definitions of Completion are equivalent, referencing the Acquisition and Agreement terms.

judgments.en_span: "Conditions" means the conditions precedent to Completion as set out in the Agreement
judgments.zh_span: 「條件」指本協議所載完成的先決條件
judgments.explanation: Both definitions of Conditions are equivalent, referring to conditions precedent in the Agreement.

judgments.en_span: "connected person(s)" has the meaning ascribed to it under the Listing Rules
judgments.zh_span: 「關連人士」具有上市規則所賦予的涵義
judgments.explanation: Both definitions defer to the Listing Rules for the meaning of connected persons/關連人士.
